name: Wonderchat
description: Wonderchat is a no code chatbot platform builder that lets you build custom AI-powered chatbots for your sites in less than 5 minutes.

events.d: Send a question to a chosen chatbot and get its reply. Set context, context URL, up to 5 images, or chatlog ID.
Update the feedback status for an individual message (thumbs up or thumbs down).
Update the feedback status for an individual message (thumbs up or thumbs down).
Add site pages to a chatbot by specifying chatbot ID, URLs, and optional session cookie.
Export chat logs for a selected chatbot; include messages, set limit, date range, or cursor.
Add comma-separated tags to a selected chat log.
Create a new message in a selected chat log.
Update a selected chat log's name, email, phone, user ID, or custom fields by supplying its chatlog ID.
Runs when new chat logs are created within a selected time window.
Remove one or more tags from a selected chat log. Choose the chat log and tags to delete.
Delete one or more pages from a selected chatbot by entering the chatbot ID and page URLs.
